name: Branco Weiss Fellowship - Society in Science
funder: Branco Weiss Fellowship (administered by ETH Zurich)
amount: Up to CHF 600,000 over 5 years (salary, equipment, travel, consumables, personnel)
other_rules: PhD held by 15 January of the award year and obtained no more than 5 years earlier (up to 1 year extra for parental leave or illness)
research must depart from the mainstream
must attend the annual symposium in the Greater Zurich Area
mentor can support only one applicant per round
notes: 2027 call is open; check the Timelines page for the exact deadline. Any field of natural science, engineering or social science. 2.5-year pioneer phase then review before the 2.5-year exploitation phase; fellows may take a faculty post after year 1. Documents: 1-page motivation letter, 5-page proposal, CV, host invitation letter, 3 best publications, 5 suggested reviewers.

documents.name: Letter of motivation
documents.notes: Include how the research differs from the mainstream

documents.name: Three best publications
documents.notes: Peer-reviewed articles or book chapters only
